description: Each media type's rate is its total Bytes divided by its total Milliseconds; list the media types whose rate is above the unweighted mean of all media types' rates, with the rate and how far above it is.

a.request: For each media type (grouped by name, using only tracks that are linked to a media type), compute its byte rate as the media type's total `Bytes` divided by its total `Milliseconds`. Then take the simple average of these rates across all media types. Which media types have a rate above that overall average? For each, give the media type name, its rate, and how far it is above the overall average (rate minus average), without rounding.
a.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT r.media_type_name, r.rate, r.rate - o.average_rate AS above_average FROM media_rates AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.rate > o.average_rate

b.request: List each media type with tracks whose total Bytes divided by total Milliseconds exceeds the unweighted average of that rate across media types with tracks; show its name, rate, and unrounded amount above the average
b.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), average_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM media_rates) SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.rate - a.rate AS amount_above_average FROM media_rates AS r CROSS JOIN average_rate AS a WHERE r.rate > a.rate

c.request: Which media types (by name, counting only tracks that have a media type) have a bytes-per-millisecond rate higher than the simple average of that rate across all media types? For each, show the media type name, its rate, and how much it exceeds that average, unrounded. Each media type's rate is its total Bytes divided by its total Milliseconds; list the media types whose rate is above the unweighted mean of all media types' rates, with the rate and how far above it is.
c.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), average_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM media_rates) SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, m.rate, m.rate - a.rate AS amount_above_average FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN average_rate AS a WHERE m.rate > a.rate

d.request: Which media types, by name, have a bytes-per-millisecond rate above the unweighted mean of all media types’ rates? Count only tracks with a media type, calculate each rate as total Bytes divided by total Milliseconds, and show each qualifying media type’s rate and how far it exceeds the mean, unrounded.
d.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType AS mt JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM media_rates) SELECT mr.Name, mr.rate, mr.rate - m.rate AS amount_above_mean FROM media_rates AS mr CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS m WHERE mr.rate > m.rate
